_comment: What does not go with the day (Jonah, 2026-10-06). Any sky goes dark with the
day, coloured ones too, so `purple sky` is purple by day and black by night; `unfading purple sky` is purple
at midnight. `fades` is one name on the vault and the stars, so `unfading stars` keeps them out through the
day as bright as at midnight -- the day-stars step, written on purpose -- and an unfading Age does both.
